**Miguel Angel López Jr.** is a Spanish-American Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2012 to 2015, designing cars for both the Hot Wheels and [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox) lines. He designed Hot Wheels cars such as the [Fast 4WD](/wiki/Fast_4WD) and [X-Steam](/wiki/X-Steam), as well as a number of Star Wars and Disney Character Cars. He is currently a freelance artist, having been one since leaving Mattel, with his notable works now being a number of vehicles for the *Paw Patrol* line of toys manufactured by competing brand Spin Master. In addition to his work as an artist, López also worked as an English teacher from 2015 to 2017, first in Madrid, Spain and then later in Tokyo, Japan. He is currently based in Japan.
